basic_details.short_information: Rajan Babu Institute for Pulmonary Medicine & Tuberculosis (RBIPMT), Municipal Corporation of Delhi has invited applications for 4 posts of Senior Resident (Chest & TB) under Advt No. 2367/DIR/RBIPMT/2026. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 7 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft (non-refundable) in favour of Commissioner MCD Delhi.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 45 years (as on last day of submission of application)

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS from MCI/NMC recognised university plus PG degree/DNB/Diploma in concerned specialty, with Delhi Medical Council registration. If adequate candidates are not available, MBBS with two years of experience (01 year in concerned specialty) can be considered.
qualification.details: Qualification: MBBS Degree from MCI/NMC Recognized University/Institution; PG degree/DNB/Diploma in concerned Specialty from a recognized University or Institute & same is registered with Delhi Medical council; Registration Certificate of Delhi Medical Council; If adequate candidates are not available in a particular specialty, MBBS Degree with two years of experience, out of which 01 year in concerned specialty, can be considered Experience: Only for the alternative route: two years of experience, of which 01 year in the concerned specialty Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on last day of submission of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years | Other conditions: | PG qualification must be registered with Delhi Medical Council OBC certificate must be issued by competent authority of Govt. of India No private practice whatsoever allowed during residency Inter-hospital/inter-institutional duties shall normally be not permitted

how_to_apply: Report to the office of the Director/RBIPMT, GTB Nagar Delhi-110009 on 07-12-2026.
Register between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM on 07-12-2026.
Bring a duly filled application form and one passport size photograph.
Bring all original documents and submit one self-attested set.
Pay fee by non-refundable Demand Draft in favour of Commissioner MCD Delhi (PwD exempted).
important_instructions: Incomplete application will not be considered and summarily rejected 4% of seats reserved for PwD and 10% for EWS candidates Preference shall be given to PwD and EWS candidates No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in interview Joining subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates

content_sections.heading: RBIPMT Senior Resident (Chest & TB) Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.rajan_babu_institute_for_pulmonary_medic: Rajan Babu Institute for Pulmonary Medicine & Tuberculosis (RBIPMT), Delhi

MBBS from MCI/NMC recognised university plus PG degree/DNB/Diploma in concerned specialty, with Delhi Medical Council registration. If adequate candidates are not available, MBBS with two years of experience (01 year in concerned specialty) can be considered.
Maximum 45 years (as on last day of submission of application)
Office of the Director/RBIPMT, GTB Nagar, Delhi

content_sections.heading: RBIPMT Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 2367/DIR/RBIPMT/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RBIPMT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS Degree from MCI/NMC Recognized University/Institution; PG degree/DNB/Diploma in concerned Specialty from a recognized University or Institute & same is registered with Delhi Medical council; Registration Certificate of Delhi Medical Council; If adequate candidates are not available in a particular specialty, MBBS Degree with two years of experience, out of which 01 year in concerned specialty, can be considered Experience: Only for the alternative route: two years of experience, of which 01 year in the concerned specialty Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on last day of submission of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years Other conditions: PG qualification must be registered with Delhi Medical Council OBC certificate must be issued by competent authority of Govt. of India No private practice whatsoever allowed during residency Inter-hospital/inter-institutional duties shall normally be not permitted

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Not specified in the notice. Engagement for one year initially, extendable by one year at a time up to total of three years, subject to satisfactory work and conduct report Total tenure of Senior Residency will not normally exceed three years including period served in other Govt. Hospitals Candidates already having 3 years of senior residency: total tenure will not exceed five years Tenure can be terminated at any time without assigning any reason Residency gives no claim or right to regular appointment to any post Terms governed by Residency Scheme, GOI OM No. 11014/3/91-ME (P) dated 05.06.1992 and amendments

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft (non-refundable) in favour of Commissioner MCD Delhi.

content_sections.heading: How Will RBIPMT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Registration between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM on 07-12-2026, interview from 9:30 AM onwards Candidates who completed 3 years of senior residency are placed on a separate list, considered after the list of fresh candidates is exhausted Chairman of the Interview Board reserves the right to consider or reject any application

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form and 01 passport size photograph Matriculation and Senior Secondary Certificate MBBS degree + PG Degree/DNB/Diploma, and mark sheets of professional examinations FMGE score card from NBEMS (foreign graduates) and internship completion certificate SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate if claimed, experience certificates if any, residence proof DMC registration certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RBIPMT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Report to the office of the Director/RBIPMT, GTB Nagar Delhi-110009 on 07-12-2026. Register between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM on 07-12-2026. Bring a duly filled application form and one passport size photograph. Bring all original documents and submit one self-attested set. Pay fee by non-refundable Demand Draft in favour of Commissioner MCD Delhi (PwD exempted).

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete application will not be considered and summarily rejected 4% of seats reserved for PwD and 10% for EWS candidates Preference shall be given to PwD and EWS candidates No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in interview Joining subject to medical fitness and verification of certificates

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for RBIPMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 7 December 2026, and candidates report at 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RBIPMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies for Senior Resident (Chest & TB).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RBIPMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 7 December 2026 at 9:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of the Director/RBIPMT, GTB Nagar, Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/OBC/EWS: Rs. 1000. SC/ST: Rs. 500. PwD: Exempted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on last day of submission of application). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per Residency Scheme.

faq.question: Q8. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS from MCI/NMC recognised university plus PG degree/DNB/Diploma in concerned specialty, with Delhi Medical Council registration. If adequate candidates are not available, MBBS with two years of experience (01 year in concerned specialty) can be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. PG qualification must be registered with Delhi Medical Council. OBC certificate must be issued by competent authority of Govt. of India. No private practice whatsoever allowed during residency. Inter-hospital/inter-institutional duties shall normally be not permitted.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Registration between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM on 07-12-2026, interview from 9:30 AM onwards. Candidates who completed 3 years of senior residency are placed on a separate list, considered after the list of fresh candidates is exhausted. Chairman of the Interview Board reserves the right to consider or reject any application.
